scope: Original v1 selects all first-step moves. Keep one expiring option on the highest-valued qualifying planter's actual landing. On the next public observation yield to v1 unless that same worker and target still qualify. If exercising would change a different command, legal action or collision safety, take the v1 joint action.
reserve: one cheapest dynamic hire after all concurrent base orders and other prospective planter payments. Do not assume any new deposit or tree absorption during this step.
opponent_training: Use existing public ladder training and validation/test geography, excluding all maps involving source Master3s2 or related names. No examiner actions, weights, internal forecasts or rollout results for fitting. The output conditional first-tenure net already subtracts the actual purchase, and is not debited a second time.
selection_rule: For each preassigned physical seat on its different development map, take the first real observation at which the two-turn controller exercises and the deployed package would actually diverge from the frozen v1. The previous move must have been selected by frozen v1 with no earlier intervened action, and independently replays from the true public history. If either fixed map has no such root, or if held-out model value ordering fails, stop before examiner runs. Future original commands, scores and tree income are excluded from root selection.
branch_arms: Fix the opponent command at the original simultaneous decision where the option is exercised. Change only that planter action. Thereafter both arms use unmodified v1 and fresh full original Master3s2 responses through the official terminal. Same initial policy-visible history and paired opponent stream per root. Each of the four unselected-outcome arms is included. Offline root trajectories are diagnostics, never causal branch labels.
training_gate: Both disjoint held-out ladder test strata must have at least one actual purchase and higher realized net in highest than in lowest predicted quartile. Diagnostic only outside the observed behavior distribution.
population_scope: Two conditionally selected development roots, no population win-rate or strategic effect guarantee.
